text:
Alex (prod): Quick cross-team check — we're aiming to land the pricing + packaging change next Wed. Need clear owners for metering schema, billing adapter rollout, quota mapping, and contract wording. Status + blockers pls.

Sam (eng): Heads up, PR for the packaging logic is merged to canary. The runtime changes are behind a feature flag: `pkg_v2_rollout`. Need metering schema v1->v2 migration plan.

Priya (billing): Thanks. Metering schema diffs looked fine but we found one gap: embeddings are still billed under the old unit name `embed_v1`. We need a mapping table otherwise invoices will split. Sample mapping I need from eng:
```json
{"embed_v1":"embedding.unit","text_v1":"token.unit"}
```
Can Sam or @Sam (eng) confirm keys?

Sam (eng): Confirmed. We'll emit both `embed_v1` and `embedding.unit` for a 2-week overlap. I'll add a translation layer in the metering proxy and a feature flag to flip after the overlap.

Liam (sre): What's the expected traffic increase from packaging change? We should size quotas and alerting — early signals to watch: `metering-proxy-errors`, `billing-lag-ms`, token/sec per customer.

Priya (billing): Traffic shouldn't change much, but some customers will see more fine-grained units which can bump invoice line counts. ETA on proxy change?

Sam (eng): Proxy change PR by EOD tomorrow. Will include metrics and a compatibility header: `X-Metering-Version: v2`.

Nora (legal): Quick contract flag: we need to ensure the contract language allows unit renames without re-signature. If anyone expects a customer-visible unit name change, we should prepare a one-paragraph addendum for enterprise customers. I can draft it if product approves.

Alex (prod): Please draft. Product wants minimal customer noise — so plan is: 1) dual-write for 2 weeks, 2) update pricing UI to show new unit names but keep historical invoices unchanged, 3) notify top 10 customers proactively.

Priya (billing): Two operational asks from billing side: (a) a mapping CSV with columns `old_unit,new_unit,effective_ts` by Tuesday; (b) a test invoice run for a sandbox tenant after proxy is live.

Sam (eng): Will provide mapping CSV. Can @Liam (sre) spin up a sandbox to run test invoice?

Liam (sre): Yes, I can. Need the sandbox tenant id and sample usage payloads. Priya, can you share an obfuscated sample payload?

Priya (billing): Sharing in DM. Also adding a small checklist here: 
- [ ] mapping CSV (eng)
- [ ] proxy dual-write (eng)
- [ ] billing adapter test run (sre + billing)
- [ ] pricing UI copy update (product + design)
- [ ] legal addendum draft (legal)

Sam (eng): One more technical note: quota system expects `quota_unit` in requests. The new packaging will emit `billing_unit`. I'll add a compatibility shim in the gateway that maps `billing_unit -> quota_unit` for the rollout window. Need owners for quota rule updates.

Alex (prod): Owner for quota rules?@Liam (sre) or @Sam (eng)?

Liam (sre): SRE can own the rollout of quota-rule changes (railgun), but eng needs to provide the mapping table and a test plan.

Sam (eng): Noted. I'll add the mapping table to the PR.

Nora (legal): Drafting contract addendum now. Will ping when ready for review.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment of `pkg_v2_rollout` successful (canary-03).

Alex (prod): Excellent. Last ask — please add a single-line status comment to the PRs with the checklist items above so PM can close after verification. If anything slips, call it out in this thread.

Sam (eng): Will do.

Priya (billing): Confirming: mapping CSV by Tue, proxy dual-write by Wed morning, test invoice Thu, legal addendum Fri. If that schedule holds, billing is green.

Liam (sre): I'll reserve extra monitoring quota and schedule an on-call for the rollout window.

Alex (prod): Thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll roll next Wed midnight PT.

Sam (eng): No objections from eng.

Priya (billing): No objections from billing.

Nora (legal): No objections from legal (will finish doc by Fri).

Alex (prod): Great — closing for now, ping here with any update. :thumbsup:
